brief.scope: Lane fix batch 1, the skeptic pass: judge the tests on this ref against the contract in the input file (scope items 1 to 12 and the plan, section 4 slices A, B, C). The tests are landed on this ref, red first: ops/conductor/tests (slice A), ops/devlane/dispatch/tests and ops/devlane/task/tests (slice B), ops/conductor/tests/test_land_lever.py and .claude/skills/pr-overview/tests (slice C). Known and prescribed by plan 3.3: the planted conf drops DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, so every test in test_dispatch_wrapper.py is red at this ref for that one reason; judge whether the tests still discriminate once the key is retired. No implementation exists yet; do not write one.

findings.finding: The expected schema is read from launch.ENVELOPE_SCHEMA_JSON, the producer under test. A launcher exposing and appending a stale Codex/Grok schema therefore agrees with its own test oracle.
findings.broken_implementation: Expose and append a schema permitting string findings for Codex/Grok while retaining Claude's correct schema.

findings.finding: Only Bash(gh pr *) is planted as a network-reaching allow. The prescribed Bash(git *) and Bash(composer *) exclusions, malformed JSON, and non-string rules are untested.
findings.broken_implementation: Drop only Bash(gh rules while admitting Bash(git *) and Bash(composer *), and fail rather than record malformed settings as unresolved.

findings.finding: The tests do not establish that wait waits, reaches its wall, returns exact terminal values, or that the launcher prints the id at mint rather than close.
findings.broken_implementation: Return immediately with fabricated field labels; immediately emit one poll and exit 2 on the wall path; print record: only after launch completion.

findings.finding: Only session.stream, spend.total, and private-key absence are compared.
findings.broken_implementation: Clear stream_sha256_at_close, model.ran, model.read_from, cached/output/source spend fields, and overwrite result.cause while preserving only stream and total.

findings.finding: Post-resume storage is asserted using only codex-stream/grok-stream substrings in the record; physical relocation is not checked.
findings.broken_implementation: Restore the store before child start, never move it forward afterward, and leave a stale recorded path containing the expected substring.

findings.finding: The sole negative case mutates only verify.exit although the contract also requires at, by, and head.
findings.broken_implementation: Require verify.exit == 0 while accepting missing or wrongly typed at, by, and head.

findings.finding: The commit check requires only a subject prefix, any Co-Authored-By trailer, and the running-model string anywhere; several required collection fields are unasserted.
findings.broken_implementation: Discard the harness message body, credit another model, mention the running model only in prose, and omit collected.at/by/verify.command/reason, changed_paths, or residual_patch.

findings.finding: The checked HEAD is the lineage repository's, not the snapshot's; verify wall and isolation behavior are also untested.
findings.broken_implementation: Commit the unverified snapshot, then refuse without moving the dispatch ref or record.

findings.finding: The positive case observes only dry-run JSON and explicitly prevents launch, while acceptance requires both inputs staged under in/.
findings.broken_implementation: Serialize both inputs in dry-run but forward only the second on the foreground path.

findings.finding: Non-dry launcher provenance, the launcher-pid line, and launcher.log contents are not asserted.
findings.broken_implementation: Omit runtime launcher provenance and launcher-pid, and merely touch an empty launcher.log.

findings.finding: PR presence uses substring assertions instead of an exact count of distinct row blocks; the all-unreadable case does not require the first underlying error.
findings.broken_implementation: Render one block mentioning both PR numbers and emit only 'none of 2' without the first failure cause.

findings.finding: This test was not red first; the author record declares it already green on the no-implementation ref.
findings.broken_implementation: A no-op implementation already satisfies the claimed red gate.

findings.finding: looked_in passes when an entry merely contains the word grok.
findings.broken_implementation: Record looked_in as ["grok"] without naming any examined store root.

findings.finding: The positive case does not require a P-LEV-1 live row or the sibling path.
findings.broken_implementation: Omit the live P-LEV-1 result and print 'sibling default' in unrelated output.

findings.finding: Generic expected/found/satisfy prose plus a class token passes; wrapper cases require only the offending path or key.
findings.broken_implementation: Omit the specified session id, examined paths, observed value, and actionable remedy from refusals.
